'''Sartran Corporation''' was a company in operation during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

In [[14 BBY/Legends|14 BBY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] nationalized the Sartran Corporation, and many of its personnel were branded as traitors and imprisoned, where many [[Death/Legends|died]], never knowing the reason for their incarceration. Among those arrested was the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Lens Reekeene|Lens]].
